CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."appointments" (
  "branchId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "cancellationReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamp,
  "cancelledByMembershipId" character(36),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "professionalMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "serviceId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
  "treatmentId" character(36),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."clinical_encounters" (
  "appointmentId" character(36),
  "branchId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "chiefComplaint" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "diagnosis" text,
  "endedAt" timestamp,
  "evolution" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "procedurePerformed" text,
  "professionalMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "recommendations" text,
  "startedAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "treatmentId" character(36),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."clinical_files" (
  "appointmentId" character(36),
  "bucket" text NOT NULL,
  "capturedAt" timestamp,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "checksumSha256" text,
  "clinicalEncounterId" character(36),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp,
  "description" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "objectKey" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "originalFilename" text NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "storageProvider" text NOT NULL,
  "treatmentId" character(36),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "uploadedByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."clinical_histories" (
  "allergies" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "currentMedications" text,
  "dentalHistory" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "medicalHistory" text,
  "observations" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "relevantConditions" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."dental_services" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "basePriceMinor" int4,
  "code" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text,
  "description" text,
  "durationMinutes" int4,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."patients" (
  "address" text,
  "birthDate" timestamp,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "deleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp,
  "documentNumber" text,
  "documentType" text,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "sex" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."payments" (
  "amountMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "appointmentId" character(36),
  "branchId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "clinicalEncounterId" character(36),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "paymentMethod" text NOT NULL,
  "receivedByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'COMPLETED' NOT NULL,
  "treatmentId" character(36),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "voidedAt" timestamp,
  "voidedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."radiographs" (
  "clinicalFileId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "laterality" text,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "radiographType" text NOT NULL,
  "region" text,
  "takenAt" timestamp,
  "toothNumber" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "dentistry"."treatments" (
  "agreedPriceMinor" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text,
  "diagnosis" text,
  "endedAt" timestamp,
  "estimatedSessions" int4,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "responsibleMembershipId" character(36),
  "serviceId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedByMembershipId" character(36),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
